$description: Fly Emirates design tokens (unofficial concept). W3C DTCG format. Same values as tokens.css. Each token carries: com.flyemirates.css (exact CSS name and value per mode), com.flyemirates.modes (authored values for md/lg/xl breakpoints and Arabic), com.flyemirates.source (attribution) and com.flyemirates.usedBy (component ids). Authored dimensions are px; tokens.css emits rem where noted in foundations/.
